description: Boss arena with stamina, dodge invulnerability frames, three boss phases, telegraphed attacks, stagger windows, healing charges and terminal states.

requirements.text: Dodge consumes stamina and grants a bounded invulnerability window.
requirements.check: Dodge consumes stamina and grants a bounded invulnerability window.

requirements.text: Boss telegraphs major attacks before damaging hit windows.

requirements.text: Health thresholds trigger phase two and three exactly once.

requirements.text: Attacks during stagger windows apply expected damage; out-of-range attacks do not.

requirements.text: Healing consumes one charge and caps health at maximum.
